name: fadeno
description: A meta-harness for subagent workflows: route archetypes to models, spawn subagents in scaffolded worktrees, and keep a ledger of every dispatch.

interface.shortDescription: Route delegated work by archetype in scaffolded worktrees.
interface.longDescription: Fadeno is a meta-harness for subagent workflows. It routes archetypes to models, gives each dispatch a scaffolded git worktree and contract, and records the lifecycle in a ledger.
defaultPrompt: Route this task to a Fadeno archetype.
